episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.summary: Hezekiah and Alec arrive in London to make their fortunes and meet the alluring criminal, Mary Carr.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.summary: Hezekiah and Sugar's rivalry takes root, as Mary steps up her heist plans.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.summary: A bombing shakes up Wapping, disturbing Hezekiah and threatening Mary and Sugar's plans.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.summary: It's the night of Mary Carr's heist and all the pieces are in place, including Hezekiah and Lao.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.summary: As Hezekiah rises in the boxing world, Mary suffers from the fallout of Lao's actions at the heist.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.summary: Reeling from shock, Hezekiah prepares for his title fight whilst the noose closes in around Mary.

episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.summary: Hezekiah is a shadow of the man he once was, and Sugar Goodson drinks himself to death.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.summary: London isn't done with Hezekiah. Mary makes her next move, and a battle looms.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.summary: The battle unfolds with devastating consequences, and Mary reveals her newly arrived accomplice.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.summary: The fight nights return. Sugar faces a difficult choice, and Sophie realises she needs Mary's help.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.summary: Sugar confronts Treacle. Hezekiah's student faces his opponent, as Mary's life hangs in the balance.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.summary: As Murtagh's grip tightens, things come to a head for Hezekiah, Sugar, and Mary.
